run.name: Mativ Holdings, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (MATV)
run.summary: Mativ is a leveraged but liquid specialty materials credit whose strength is adequate and improving, not yet comfortable. Refinancing and liquidity support it; thin earnings coverage and the 2029 notes are the pressure points. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Net sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, reported basis, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Reported basis, EBITDA 210.0 from FY2025 less nine months 2025 plus nine months 2026 (10-Q Q3 page:2, page:4; 10-K page:75, page:77). Total debt 976.4 and net debt 879.1 (10-Q Q3 page:12; Release Q3 page:11). Management states 3.8x (10-Q Q3 page:28). Adjusted LTM EBITDA Not calculable: no fourth quarter 2025 adjusted figure.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. EBITDA 210.0 over LTM cash interest 80.1 (82.8 less 55.2 plus 52.5; 10-Q Q3 page:5). On interest expense instead of cash interest the ratio is 2.92x (LTM expense 71.9). Management basis for nine months 2026 only: adjusted EBITDA 184.8 over cash interest 52.5 is 3.52x (not a trailing figure).

cash.basis: Cash. Printed undrawn capacity on the 305.0 revolver (10-Q Q3 page:28); restricted cash 4.2 excluded (UK pension scheme, 10-Q Q3 page:27). Of the cash, 72.7 is held by foreign subsidiaries (10-Q Q3 page:27). Printed capacity is 8.8 below commitment less drawings at every date; the cause (letters of credit or other usage) is not supplied.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The financing documents and an annual adjusted earnings figure are missing, so covenant headroom and management's leverage cannot be tested.
CP-1 main limitation: Management leverage uses an adjusted earnings definition and agreement text that are not in the sources, so covenant headroom cannot be tested.
